panels.title: Ready frontier vs target
panels.description: Slices in the dispatcher's ready frontier at each dreamer pass, against the target its admission derives: the launches allowed now plus the sessions expected to finish before the next pass.

panels.title: Slices generated per source
panels.description: Slices the dreamer added, by the source of their work, and the strategy's exploration weight.

panels.title: Objective: struggles per 1k tool calls, latest complete week
panels.description: The struggle rate on all runs with its 95% Garwood interval, and the weekly compounding factor with its 95% interval; exponential improvement is the factor below 1 and staying there.

panels.title: Held-out vs in-sample improvement
panels.description: The weekly struggle factor with its 95% interval on the in-sample runs the dreamer chooses work from and on the held-out runs it never reads; a gain that shows in-sample only is overfitting.
